CustomField.description: Hours an approval waits for a decision, from 1 to 168. Blank uses 24 hours. An authorization policy timeout overrides it.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Time allowed for an approval decision, in hours. Blank uses 24. When the deadline passes, Approval Expiry Action determines whether the agent continues without the call or pauses for an operator.
CustomField.label: Approval Timeout (Hours)
